tooltip.robotica.tinkers_bench: Adds upgrade cards to power tools
tooltip.robotica.gear.kit.1: Smithing template: Tinker's Hammer to Bore Drill, Felling Axe to Chainsaw, Gearblade to Shock Baton
tooltip.robotica.gear.kit.2: Smithing template: Bore Drill to Servo Drill
tooltip.robotica.gear.kit.3: Smithing template: Servo Drill to Magma Drill, Shock Baton to Arc Blade
tooltip.robotica.gear.kit.4: Smithing template: Magma Drill to Null Drill, Rivet Gun to Null Lance
item.robotica.shock_baton.tooltip: 7 damage, Slowness II, %s FE per hit
item.robotica.rivet_gun.tooltip: Right-click: fast rivet, 4 shots/s, %s FE per shot
item.robotica.arc_blade.tooltip: Arcs half damage to 3 nearby hostiles, %s FE per hit
item.robotica.null_lance.tooltip: Hold 1 s, release: piercing beam, %s FE per shot
gear.robotica.screen.title: Tool settings
gear.robotica.toggle.keep_floor.desc: Area modes never dig below your feet
gear.robotica.toggle.auto_pickup.desc: Drops go straight into your inventory
gear.robotica.toggle.void_filter.desc: Deletes cobblestone, dirt, gravel and other junk
gear.robotica.toggle.auto_smelt.desc: Ores and sand come out smelted
gear.robotica.screen.mode.desc: Click: next mode. Shift-click: previous. Same as the mode key
gear.robotica.screen.enchant.desc: Puts Silk Touch or Fortune on the tool, or neither
gear.robotica.hud.empty: Empty: charge it in a Charger
tooltip.robotica.gear.fe_per_block: %s FE per block. Unbreaking lowers it
tooltip.robotica.gear.key_mode: %s next mode (sneak: previous). Sneak + scroll works too
tooltip.robotica.gear.sneak_single: Hold sneak to mine a single block in any mode
tooltip.robotica.gear.slow_area: Area modes mine at %s%% speed: still far faster than block by block
tooltip.robotica.gear.enchantable: Takes normal enchantments: Efficiency, Fortune, Silk Touch, Unbreaking
tooltip.robotica.gear.what.tinkers_hamme: Mines 1x1 or 3x3. In a crafting grid with 2 ingots it makes a plate
tooltip.robotica.gear.what.felling_axe: Cuts a whole tree with one swing and replants a sapling from your inventory
tooltip.robotica.gear.what.bore_drill: FE drill: mines like an iron pickaxe, or 3x3. Never breaks. A cell in your inventory recharges it
tooltip.robotica.gear.what.chainsaw: Fells a whole tree with its leaves, then replants. Runs on FE
tooltip.robotica.gear.what.servo_drill: Adds 5x5 and vein mining (up to 64 connected ores)
tooltip.robotica.gear.what.magma_drill: Adds 3x3x3 and 9x9. Auto-smelt in the settings
tooltip.robotica.gear.what.null_drill: Adds 5x5x5, 12x12 and 12x12x12. Big breaks run over a few ticks
